description: This file defines the CloudSyncManager class responsible for synchronizing calendar and leave data with a remote cloud service. It includes extension functions for serializing and deserializing CalendarEvent and Leave objects to and from a Map representation suitable for remote storage.

classes.name: CloudSyncManager
classes.description: Main class for handling synchronization between local data and remote cloud storage, relying on a CalendarRepository.

methods.name: syncData
methods.description: Synchronizes local data with remote cloud data, considering the last sync time.
